rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'kurai kurai'; read as 'kurae' (sibling clip).
Zentradi-style word; Whisper wrote 'debura', not understood.
Whisper wrote 'fighter, fighter, fighter'; the matching clip in the other version is a short grunt. Not a real line.
Whisper wrote 'nununu'; matching clip is a grunt.
Whisper wrote 'muzamadama'; read as 'buzama da na' (sibling clip).
Whisper wrote 'hey hey hey'; read as a battle cry like the sibling clip.
Whisper wrote 'watashi no aite da'; sibling clip has 'watashi ga aite da'.
Whisper wrote 'asonde aru'; read as 'asonde yaru ka' (sibling clip).
Whisper wrote 'don't aim there'; sibling clip has 'if I aim there'. Clause cut off.

rows.en: In the end, you're no match for me.

rows.notes: Laughter, no words.
Whisper wrote 'ikki gekitsui' with wrong kanji; read as one aircraft shot down, as in the sibling clip.

rows.en: They put up no fight at all.
Have some shame, as a warrior.

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'shimashita shield'; read as 'shimatta, shield o' (sibling clip).
Trails off.

rows.en: Don't get cocky just because you took out my shield.

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'yaru yo da ga'; read as 'yaru you da na' (sibling clip).
Fragment, no verb.
Whisper wrote 'shimashita'; read as 'shimatta'.
Whisper wrote 'gekikyou' (extreme strength); read as 'gekitsuiou' (ace) like the sibling clip. Cut off.
Whisper wrote 'baka baka'; read as 'baka na'.
Whisper wrote 'konkon'; read as 'kono...' like the sibling clip.

rows.en: I hate you for branding me with defeat.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'inochi o ikasaseta' (made me live); read as 'ommei o kisaseta' (made me wear disgrace) from the sibling clip.

rows.en: Dying in battle is the best!

rows.notes: Trails off.

rows.en: Enemies this weak? I'm enough by myself.
rows.notes: Whisper wrote a garbled first half; sibling clip gives the sense.

rows.en: Reinforcements, huh? Well, thanks for the effort.

rows.notes: Defense-target failure group; 'it' is the target, assumed.
Whisper wrote a garbled katakana string; sibling clip is 'mamotte yarenakatta ka'.
Short shout (eifosu), no clear words.
Whisper wrote 'timeline'; sibling clip is 'fun, taai no nai'.

rows.en: To think it would end like this.
Damn, I was distracted by the enemy.
I'll wash away this disgrace someday, I swear!
rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'chitsujo' (order); read as 'chijoku' (disgrace) from the sibling clip.
Whisper wrote 'teki'; read as 'ada' (vengeance).

rows.en: I-I lost... Me, of all people...

rows.notes: Whisper wrote 'egoshiro'; read as 'engo shiro' (sibling clip).
Whisper wrote 'torikome'; read as 'tobikome' (dive in).
Whisper wrote 'taiji shiro' (exterminate); read as 'taiki shiro' (hold).
Whisper wrote 'muryou' (free); read as 'muyou' (needless).
